why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://portrait.so   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Portrait site Go to the Portrait homepage and read how the link-in-bio page and the wallet fit together.
2 Step 2 : Sign up for a Portrait Press Sign up on the homepage to start your page; if you already have a Portrait, use the Log in link next to it.
3 Step 3 : Pick a frame and fill it Choose a frame for your grid, then add images, videos, links or text and adjust its size and position.
4 Step 4 : Apply for wallet early access On an iPhone, use the Apply for early access button on the homepage to try Portrait Wallet, which is live on iOS through TestFlight.
5 Step 5 : Try sending by username Inside the wallet, send money to another person with their Portrait username instead of a wallet address.
